question: In June 2024, which of the following Indian cities was officially recognised as World Craft City by the World Crafts Council?
solution:

• **Srinagar was officially recognized as a World Craft City **by the World Crafts Council (WCC) in June 2024.
 
• It is the fourth Indian city to receive this recognition. 
 
• The WCC **works to protect heritage and support artisans globally. **
